limitations.message: A file being in the folder doesn't prove the app runs it: it may be unused, left over from an update, or there for another reason. Nothing was started, so these are inferences.
Only names, the ends of some files and the start of the main programs were read. The app's contents weren't unpacked or analysed; next_steps says what to run for that.
